content:
{'translation': 'Rachel Maddow said on Saturday that President Trump\'s decision to bar CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House is a callback to his old campaign rally tactic: whipping up supporters to boo the "fake news."', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Appearing on colleague Peter Alexander\'s show "State of Play," the MS NOW host recalled days covering campaign rallies where Trump would frequently use "dishonest" reporting as a topic to pivot the crowd\'s attention toward the press pen and get supporters to jeer at journalists.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': '"We will experience the Orwellian two minutes of hate," Maddow said.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': '"The whole crowd will turn to them and scream and shout, and Trump loves that reaction," she continued.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Maddow said Trump\'s persistently low approval ratings, combined with his unpopular war in Iran, have left him unable to "mobilize the base" like he once could, and the same "gimmicks," "moves," "crowd manipulation tricks" and "authoritarian personality tics" don\'t work every time.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': '"He\'s politically in such a low place that I think he\'s just retreading old material," she said.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': '"I think he is going back to doing things that his base likes, wanting to feel that vibe again. I think it\'s that simple."', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Her comments come as press figures across the spectrum have condemned Trump for barring the three major outlets from the White House over coverage he dislikes.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'At least one First Amendment expert — Jameel Jaffer, director of the Knight First Amendment Institute at Columbia University — said the decision "is clearly unconstitutional," telling NBC News it is "part of a broader pattern" by the administration to attack "the public\'s right to independent government information."', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'The White House previously briefly blocked The Associated Press last year after it refused to use Trump\'s preferred "Gulf of America" for the Gulf of Mexico — a ban a judge later ruled violated the First Amendment.', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': 'Maddow also noted earlier on her MS NOW show that Trump knows very well what he "can and can\'t do" as president, but enjoys moves like barring the press because "he likes the effect."', 'notes': ''}

{'translation': '"Sometimes the simplest explanation is the most likely correct one," she said.', 'notes': ''}
